name: Palm Springs (United States)
description: A stylised desert landscape: a yellow sun in an orange sky over purple mountains and brown sand, with a green palm tree at the hoist.
history: Palm Springs is a desert resort city in Riverside County, California, within the Colorado Desert's Coachella Valley. The flag was adopted on 7 March 1984 (designed by resident Henry Untermeyer and approved by the city council, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: desert landscape with sun, mountains and palm
